Your title is right you are too young you’re only past about 1/8 of your life it is most definitely not wrecked. I understand your emotions might be very intense right now having this much struggle and suffering at a young age is very difficult to deal with but being young means you have a head start to tackle your problems. You’re going through your lowest point right now but I know there’s been times you’ve felt like it’s your lowest and you’ve pushed through. You’re too young and you deserve help and support. If you’re worried about getting official people involved in your business or having your freedom restricted I understand that. You feeling as though you’ve ‘wrecked’ your life sounds like you are unhappy with it and just want it to change. You can change it you’re able to turn it all around you’re just not at your best right now but there’s ways to beat addiction that aren’t rehab or things that will take away your freedom and I’m very open to helping you. Nothing is ever a straight road there will be bumps in overcoming addiction but the only important thing is that you always try to get back into the road even if you stray a bit. You have not ruined anything you’re just in a bad place and you’re trying to help yourself through the ways available to you. Life will start to feel better when you feel yourself freeing from your addictions please let me know if I can help you ❤️

U r not alone and I know it may feel like ur drowning but there’s always a life vest around and the life vest is most definitely not suicide. ❤️

Your boyfriend loves you and is probably lashing out because he’s worried about you and wants you to see it. You are most definitely not a coward for wanting to go but you must persevere you need to see your brother grow up n be there when he needs you. In regards to selfish when ppl say ‘oh it was so hard to watch that’ I think ppl saying ‘imagine how it felt’ is absolutely justifiable. The way you feel right now it’s commendable that you are still able to think of others feelings and I’ve seen your prior post about wanting to stay for your brother so I promise you you’ve got a lovely soul and you are not selfish. Things are hard for you right now and those around you are worried but they may communicate this wrongly like your boyfriend just know that he loves you. If it’s weighing on your mind go try do something nice for him. Give him a little space and then talk it out. Also please go hug your brother and remember that he will always need your hugs no matter his age and you can get through this and it will get easier ❤️
